QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_23

question.text: Liquid Net Worth of a clearing member is computed as:

answer.text: Liquid assets minus initial margin and extreme loss margin
Net worth as per audited financial statements

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 178 defines liquid net worth as liquid assets minus initial margin and extreme loss margin payable, and requires clearing members to maintain the prescribed minimum liquid net worth. The Trap: Liquid net worth is a clearing-specific measure, not the accounting net worth from audited financial statements. Note: The risk-reduction restrictions on page 178 are tied to collateral utilisation crossing the prescribed percentage, not to breaching the Rs. 50 lakh liquid net worth threshold.
